measurement_limitation: agreement is measured by explicit surface patterns over free live-model text; a recipient who agrees in wording no pattern covers is scored cutoff, not success

ranking.run_limitations: Result provenance: live_model. This result identifies the best-performing action among the candidates tested under the declared evaluator metrics, computed only from recorded simulation traces; it is not a guarantee of real-world outcome. Ranking uses the declared metrics only: the primary metric (call_agreed) first, then each secondary metric compared descending in declared order (highest value first; polarity not inferred); any remaining exact tie is broken by candidate_id in ascending lexicographic order (code-owned final tie-break, applied in this ranking).
